author: Play On Tabletop
description:
Every year at Gamescon Canada Play on has headed to Edmonton Canada to host a 130 person Narrative Tournament where teams compete to further an ongoing storyline.  

This year an inquisition invading force tries to take over the system of Hostia and claim the fabled Cronus Device.  Titans shoot across tables, orbiting spaceships fire down at the planet and secret objectives must be completed.  

Come see a taste of what a narrative event is like!
